lines: Steam Guard code is handled by admins if prompted.
extra: Do not change the password or recovery email.

guide.summary: Install the launcher first, then sign in with the account.
steps: Open Steam and install Helldivers 2 from the library.
Wait for the first launch to finish shader compilation.
loginInstructions: Use the credentials from the `account` command DM.
If Steam Guard appears, contact an admin instead of retrying repeatedly.
recommendedSettings: Run borderless fullscreen for easier alt-tab behavior.
Reduce volumetric fog if performance drops.
troubleshooting: If the game loops on launch, verify the game files.
If login fails, confirm the password was copied without extra spaces.
notes: Only use this account for the purchased game access.
